steps.text: Taking the flag. `--rate-limit` on `harborctl keys set`, so a plan's ceiling can be changed without a dashboard round trip.
Parsed and validated. It refuses a value above the plan's own ceiling rather than silently clamping — a clamp reads as success and isn't.

Either. A bare integer is requests per minute. A plan name — `free`, `team` — takes that plan's ceiling from `quota.ts`, so ops can say `--rate-limit team` without knowing the figure, and it moves when the plan does.
Before I cut it — one choice the flag can't change after it ships.

options.label: Requests per minute
options.description: --rate-limit 600 — the same number the plan stores as perMinute.

options.label: Requests per second
options.description: --rate-limit 10 — closer to what the gateway's own logs report.

steps.text: Per minute it is: `--rate-limit 600` maps straight onto the plan's `perMinute`, so there's no conversion to get wrong.
Flag's in and documented in `harborctl keys set --help`. Ready for tonight's release.
